europe_now.title: Maritime Attack in Gulf of Finland
europe_now.summary: A Russia-bound cargo vessel was targeted in an attack within the Baltic Sea region, leading to a towed response and heightened regional security concerns. Finland noted that the ongoing conflict in Ukraine is spilling over into maritime routes.

sources.headline: Russia-bound ship towed away after it was attacked in Gulf of Finland
Live: Finland says war 'spilling over' after Baltic Sea drone strike on Russian cargo ship

top_stories.title: Escalating Strikes and Disruptions
top_stories.summary: Airports in Brussels and Charleroi canceled most of their scheduled flights due to a national labor strike. Citizens across parts of Europe have organized demonstrations addressing mounting living costs and public service pressures.

sources.headline: Brussels, Charleroi airports to cancel most flights Monday amid Belgian strike

top_stories.title: Diplomatic and Espionage Measures
top_stories.summary: Cyprus took formal action to expel several Russian diplomats on grounds of suspected espionage activities. The move underscores continuing diplomatic friction and security surveillance across European Union member states.
